cta.description: Extensions: shopify catalog extension active — responses may carry shop-specific enrichment beyond the core spec; `variants[*].url` is the PDP and `variants[*].checkout_url` is the buy-now target; discount extension advertised — cart/checkout may accept `discount_codes[]` and surface `discount_allocations` per line item; run --input-schema before adding discount fields; fulfillment extension advertised — delivery groups may carry richer scheduling/handle metadata than the core spec requires; run --input-schema before adding fulfillment fields. Cross-business results — each variant belongs to its own seller. Pick the seller AND variant the buyer wants (products[N].variants[M]) before proceeding. To create a cart, pass --business=<products[N].variants[M].seller.domain>. If chosen items span multiple seller.domain values, create one cart/checkout per seller. Buyer handoff: open products[N].variants[M].checkout_url for buy-now handoff when the buyer wants business-hosted checkout. More results available; paginate only if you need them.

Description Built tough enough to withstand a truck 2mm-thick, die-cast enclosure Perfect for producing “stomp box” style effects pedals Aluminum enclosure version features a smoother metal finish The Aluminum Enclosure (112x61x31mm) has been built tough enough to withstand a truck. This 2mm-thick, die-cast enclosure is rated IP54 against dust and splashing water. Because it’s aluminum, it’s easy to cut and drill so that you can add LCD screens, buttons and cable connections. Try combining this with a stomp switch and some of your own secret sauce circuitry to build a sweet custom pedal. The lid fits nicely to the top of the enclosure and is secured with 10mm long #6-32 screws (included). This aluminum enclosure version features a smoother metal finish as well as a more structurally sound design. Description Supports M2 NVMe protocol, supports PCle3.0 and PCle4.0. Supports M Key/B&M Key interface, supports 2230/2242/2260/2280 solid state drives of different sizes. Suitable for Jetson Orin Nano SUPER, Orin NX SUPER, Xavier NX and TX2 NX, be used to write system images and backup systems. Supports common home devices such as computers, TVs, routers, etc., This M.2 SSD enclosure provides you with a convenient and secure way to transform your M.2 SSD into a portable storage device. It comes with USB3.1 interface, the maximum reading speed can reach 10GBPS, allowing you to quickly transfer data between different devices. For example, it can be used to write mirror systems to Jetson series development boards. And it is made of aluminum alloy, which can protect your SSD from the external environment and provide good heat dissipation performance. Description Digilent Enclosure Kit for Ettus USRP B200/B210 (Green) Ensures robust protection for USRP boards Constructed from durable steel Features K-slots for anti-theft security Compatible with green USRP B200/B210 Safeguards against unauthorized access The Digilent Enclosure Kit for Ettus USRP B200/B210 (Green) is designed to provide robust protection for the USRP B200 and B210 boards. This kit features a custom-designed steel case that ensures the safety and security of the devices. The enclosure is specifically compatible with green USRP B200 and B210 models equipped with a USB-B connector. The enclosure is constructed entirely from steel, offering a durable and reliable shield for the sensitive components housed within. It includes strategically placed K-slots on both the front and rear panels, which serve as an anti-theft measure, enhancing the security of the enclosed devices. This enclosure kit is an essential accessory for users seeking to safeguard their USRP B200 and B210 boards from physical damage and unauthorized access, ensuring the longevity and integrity of the devices.
